question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.

WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT 
        l.id_bioguide,
        l.gender,
        lt.state,
        CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) AS first_term_start
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE lt.term_number = 0
),
check_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        id_bioguide,
        gender,
        state,
        first_term_start,
        DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(first_term_start), '-12-31')) AS year0_check,
        DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(first_term_start), '-12-31')) + INTERVAL 2 YEAR AS year2_check,
        DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(first_term_start), '-12-31')) + INTERVAL 4 YEAR AS year4_check,
        DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(first_term_start), '-12-31')) + INTERVAL 6 YEAR AS year6_check,
        DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(first_term_start), '-12-31')) + INTERVAL 8 YEAR AS year8_check,
        DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(first_term_start), '-12-31')) + INTERVAL 10 YEAR AS year10_check
    FROM first_terms
),
serving AS (
    SELECT 
        cd.id_bioguide,
        cd.gender,
        cd.state,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = cd.id_bioguide 
            AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= cd.year0_check 
            AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) > cd.year0_check
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year0_retained,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = cd.id_bioguide 
            AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= cd.year2_check 
            AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) > cd.year2_check
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year2_retained,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = cd.id_bioguide 
            AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= cd.year4_check 
            AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) > cd.year4_check
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year4_retained,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = cd.id_bioguide 
            AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= cd.year6_check 
            AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) > cd.year6_check
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year6_retained,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = cd.id_bioguide 
            AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= cd.year8_check 
            AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) > cd.year8_check
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year8_retained,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = cd.id_bioguide 
            AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= cd.year10_check 
            AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) > cd.year10_check
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year10_retained
    FROM check_dates cd
),
retention_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        SUM(year0_retained) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS year0_rate,
        SUM(year2_retained) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS year2_rate,
        SUM(year4_retained) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS year4_rate,
        SUM(year6_retained) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS year6_rate,
        SUM(year8_retained) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS year8_rate,
        SUM(year10_retained) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS year10_rate
    FROM serving
    GROUP BY state, gender
)
SELECT * FROM retention_rates
WHERE state = 'AK' AND gender = 'M'
